text:
Alex G: Heads up — code freeze goes into effect in ~2h. If you have a late-merge exception, please post justification + link to PR here. We’ll gate exceptions to: critical bugfix, security, or release-blocking infra change.

Samir: @Alex G linking PR #5129 — regression in multi-tenant routing that causes 500s for some dedicated customers. Runs local sanity, added unit+integration test. Requesting exception to merge to main. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/PR/5129

Maria V: Can you paste the CI failures you saw? Curious if it's flaky or a real regression. Also remember to add changelog entry under docs/changelog/unreleased.md.

Samir: CI failure was in prod-mock env, stack trace points to kv cache eviction. Not flaky — reproduces locally with the failing seed. Added test `TestKVEvictionRace`. CI output snippet:
```
--- FAIL: TestKVEvictionRace (0.13s)
    eviction_test.go:84: unexpected nil pointer
```
Changelog entry drafted in my branch.

Cheng Li: Branch sync note — main got the quant-opt patch earlier; if we merge 5129 we need to run the backfill job after deploy. Add this to the rollforward checklist: `make run-backfill` on the migration worker.

Irene P: Tagging infra/ops: if we approve, can SRE hold a small canary on dedicated for 30m? Would like to watch latency and 5xx rates. @Samir can you provide a short smoke test command?

Samir: Smoke test (30 requests):
```bash
# from staging network
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://dedicated.redwood.example/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"rwd-v1", "prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .status
```
Will run after merge and tag ops.

Alex G: Thanks. Quick checklist for exception approvals:
- Brief justification (why not a patch post-cutoff)
- CI status + failing logs
- Changelog entry present
- Backport/backfill plan if needed
- Ops canary plan + smoke commands

Irene P: This PR satisfies those; +1 from me pending canary results. :thumbsup:

release-bot: CODE-FREEZE NOTICE: main branch is now under soft freeze until 2070060000. Late-merge exceptions accepted via this thread and require 2 approvals (eng leads + SRE). Automated merges disabled.

Maria V: Minor nudge — please include the changelog heading `Unreleased` and bullet: "Fix: KV cache eviction causing 500s on dedicated (PR #5129)" so release notes pick it up.

Samir: Done — added changelog bullet and `backfill: migration-2026-07-kv-evict` in the PR description. Will run smoke test post-merge and monitor grafana dashboard `infra/dedicated/5xx-rate`.

Alex G: Approving exception based on description + tests + ops plan. @Irene P thanks for canary readiness. If canary looks clean after 30m, ops to promote.

Irene P: Canary finished: no increase in 5xx, latency within expected bounds. Promoting to rollout. :white_check_mark:

Samir: Merged and deployed canary. Thanks all.

Alex G: Marking thread resolved. Reminder to file a quick post-deploy note in the release checklist (#release-notes) with links to PR and backfill job output.

release-bot: REMINDER: add post-deploy note or the exception will be flagged in the release audit.
